source.description:
## PROBLEM

The contextual xtprompt prompt improver only exists as a Pi TUI extension. Users need the same structured one-shot prompt rewrite from a normal shell without starting an AgentSession or interactive Pi UI.

## SUCCESS

A standalone npm package exists at packages/xtprompt and installs an xtprompt executable. The executable accepts positional or stdin input, reuses Pi model/auth configuration through ModelRuntime, supports explicit model/intent/context controls, handles vague input safely, and emits plain text or JSON.

## SCOPE

- packages/xtprompt/ with package-local source, tests, README, manifest, and lockfile

## NON_GOALS

- No persistent conversation or AgentSession
- No automatic project-file or prior-session context discovery
- No Pi TUI integration changes
- No custom provider implementation outside Pi ModelRuntime

## CONSTRAINTS

- Use Node 24 standard-library argument parsing, stdin, and readline APIs.
- Use Pi ModelRuntime and resolveCliModel; do not implement provider clients or credential storage.
- Never print credentials, auth headers, full environment data, or prompt content to stderr.
- Plain output is the rewrite only; diagnostics go to stderr.

## VALIDATION

- [ ] Package-local unit and CLI integration tests pass.
- [ ] Coverage is at least 80% for statements, branches, functions, and lines.
- [ ] npm pack dry-run includes executable, README, and runtime source.
- [ ] A real authenticated smoke invocation returns a non-empty rewrite when auth exists.
- [ ] Failure smoke returns non-zero without secret material.

## OUTPUT

Report package files, options, verification commands, smoke evidence, coverage, and limitations.

source.description:
## PROBLEM

Epic xtrm-5kl needs a minimal shell-facing adapter around the proven xtprompt rewrite policy and Pi model runtime. The package must work without AgentSession state, tools, extension loading, or TUI APIs.

## SUCCESS

packages/xtprompt is an installable ESM npm package with an xtprompt bin. It accepts one prompt argument or stdin, supports --model, --intent, --context, --no-clarify, and --json, asks one terminal clarification for vague prompts, uses ModelRuntime.completeSimple(), validates the <xtprompt> response envelope with one retry, and documents exit behavior.

## SCOPE

- packages/xtprompt/package.json and package-lock.json
- packages/xtprompt/src/
- packages/xtprompt/README.md

## NON_GOALS

- No edits to the Pi extension
- No AgentSession, tools, skill loading, or session persistence
- No clipboard integration
- No dynamic Pi extension-provider loading

## CONSTRAINTS

- Preserve the extension intent lattice, planning headers, vague-input policy, timeout, output cap, sentinel contract, and retry behavior.
- Use Node standard library for CLI parsing and terminal input.
- Reuse Pi auth/model configuration through ModelRuntime.create() and resolveCliModel().
- Never expose secrets in diagnostics.

## VALIDATION

- [ ] Manifest exposes xtprompt and Node >=24 plus the Pi SDK dependency.
- [ ] Positional and stdin input work.
- [ ] Explicit and automatic intent work.
- [ ] Context text and @file input are bounded and advisory.
- [ ] Vague input clarifies once in a TTY or fails safely in non-TTY/no-clarify mode.
- [ ] Model resolution, auth, timeout, malformed envelope, retry, and JSON/plain output have defined behavior.
- [ ] Tests and coverage pass.

## LIBRARIES

- Reuse in repo: none found after searches for ModelRuntime, resolveCliModel, completeSimple, and xtprompt.
- Installed deps: none at repository root.
- Stdlib: node:util.parseArgs, node:readline/promises, node:fs/promises, node:process.
- New dep: @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent@^0.84.1 for Pi model/auth compatibility.
- Roll it: no provider/auth implementation; only rewrite policy and adapters.

## OUTPUT

Changed files, usage examples, test/coverage/pack/smoke evidence, and residual limitations.

source.description:
## PROBLEM

The shell package in xtrm-5kl.1 crosses argument, stdin, filesystem context, terminal clarification, Pi runtime, and output boundaries. Static checks cannot prove those paths.

## SUCCESS

Package-local tests cover pure rewrite policy and subprocess CLI behavior, including success, JSON, failures, retry, bounded context, and secret-safe diagnostics.

## SCOPE

- packages/xtprompt/test/
- Package-local test scripts and fixtures

## NON_GOALS

- No Pi provider-internal tests
- No session or TUI tests
- No live call in deterministic tests

## CONSTRAINTS

- Layer: shell + boundary; strategy: Node unit tests and subprocess integration with a fake runtime boundary, plus separate real-auth smoke.
- Do not mock internal rewrite functions. Mock only model runtime.
- Never read or print real credentials in deterministic tests.

## VALIDATION

- [ ] Positional and stdin prompts produce exact plain output.
- [ ] JSON includes prompt, intent, and model identity.
- [ ] Empty input, invalid intent/model, non-TTY vague input, malformed output, and model failure exit non-zero on stderr.
- [ ] @file context is bounded and XML delimiters are escaped.
- [ ] One malformed response retries once and valid second response succeeds.
- [ ] Coverage reaches 80% for all four metrics.
- [ ] Help smoke exits 0; authenticated rewrite smoke runs if auth exists.
- [ ] npm pack dry-run includes runtime files and excludes tests.

Critical paths covered: prompt to completion to parse to stdout; failures to non-zero stderr without secrets.
Known deferred path: extension-registered custom providers.
Debuggability: stable concise stderr and exit codes; no stored telemetry for a stateless CLI.

## OUTPUT

Exact test, coverage, pack, and smoke evidence.

Final suite after default-model change: 19/19 tests pass; coverage lines 92.42%, branches 82.26%, functions 90.32%. Final pack/install/failure smokes and npm audit remain clean.
